design: Thin overhead README banners, child-built physical LEGO letters; royal blue with orange accents throughout, per final user preference

assets.heading: Count Before You Post
assets.dominant_color: royal blue with bright orange accents
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one new coherent README section banner in the supplied reference's overhead brick-letter visual style. This is a new banner, reference only for physical materials, color, typography construction and photography. EXACT CANVAS: ultra-wide landscape 3:1 aspect ratio. Full-bleed warm wooden tabletop MUST fill the entire canvas edge to edge. NO WHITE MARGINS, NO LETTERBOX BARS, NO BORDER. Strict 90-degree overhead flat lay photograph, no perspective horizon. Main subject is the exact text "COUNT BEFORE YOU POST" assembled from small real blue LEGO-like bricks and plates with occasional orange accent bricks, lying flat on the tabletop. Each letter is a physically built toy construction with visible studs, seams, thickness and little contact shadows, NOT printed text, NOT ordinary font, NOT a signboard. All words of the requested heading must appear, accurately spelled, in ONE single horizontal line. The heading occupies most of the width and is comfortably readable at README width; keep all letters safely inside the frame. This is a thin wide section heading, not a full scene illustration. A child has taken these pieces out of the Count Before You Post kit and is assembling the title. Peripheral storytelling only: a TINY cropped corner of the open blue toy box at one far edge, a few spare blue/orange/cream/teal bricks, and a child's hand in cream knitted sleeve entering at an outer edge placing a final brick. Hands and props must not obscure any letters. No cast lineup, no warehouse backdrop, no plaques, no instruction sheet, no other readable text. Warm natural morning light, authentic toy plastic and oak grain, polished photographic realism. Vary tiny edge details naturally while keeping the series consistent. Banner 01.
assets.export: WebP quality 88, original dimensions, no crop
